title: Contamination Level
description: C0-C5 classification of an artefact's exposure risk. See docs/concepts.md#contamination.

meta:enum-meaning.C0: Public factual material or independent standards.
meta:enum-meaning.C1: Public documentation carrying minimal expressive risk.
meta:enum-meaning.C2: Reference documentation containing potentially expressive material.
meta:enum-meaning.C4: Highly sensitive implementation detail, private source or confidential material.
meta:enum-meaning.C5: Legally restricted material or material whose permissible use has not been established.
